content: Real advisories against local AI dev servers show three stacked failures: binding 0.0.0.0 rather than loopback, no Host header allowlist so DNS rebinding makes an attacker page same-origin with the local server, and no auth so a plain cross-site POST executes actions. Impact explicitly includes consuming paid LLM quota and reading prompt/response traces. Cheap mitigations that keep working on loopback: bind loopback only, reject requests whose Host is not the exact loopback host:port, reject a present foreign Origin, require Content-Type application/json on mutating routes so browser simple requests cannot reach handlers, and cap spend.
